sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Amount off discounts
sources.passage: You can create amount off discounts that give your customers a fixed value or a percentage off the products in an order, but that don't apply to shipping costs. The minimum purchase amount counts product prices only, and shipping costs and taxes aren't included. Only items that your discount applies to can count towards the minimum purchase amount, and they're counted using their prices after any earlier product discounts. For amount off product discounts and amount off order discounts, gift cards and store credit used as payment don't affect the minimum purchase amount, because they apply to the order total after discounts are calculated.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Free shipping discounts
sources.passage: A discount that can't be combined with your free shipping discount never applies at the same time, so it never changes the minimum purchase amount. Gift cards and store credit used as payment don't affect the minimum purchase amount, because they apply to the order total after discounts are calculated. ## Create a free shipping discount code Desktop The minimum purchase amount counts product prices only, and other costs such as taxes are never included in the amount. If the discount applies to a specific product or collection, then only these items contribute to the minimum purchase amount.
